unit: Share of injected fraud flagged by the gate
title: The Gate Catches Fraud Above $1,000 and Nothing Below
subtitle: First-stage gate recall by fraud amount, one 3,000 transaction synthetic run, 233 fraud transactions
caption: The 36.1 percent of injected fraud above $1,000 matched the recall (0.361) in this 3,000-transaction run. The fraud amounts come from the repo's own producer code, so this describes the gate against the repo's synthetic fraud model, not real fraud.
